integrity: The main proof is a complete perfect-matching argument on the four skein boundary points. A separate localized-rank contradiction checks the sign against the exact sequence using Hendricks--Lipshitz--Sarkar Proposition 6.3. No finite experiment is used as evidence for the universal topological statement.
scientific_limitations: The statement identifies a vacuous component-count hypothesis in Remark 2 of the cited v1 and the unique realizable equal-resolution sign. It does not challenge the main exact triangle, infer authorial intent, or prove that every localized map formula remains valid after changing the sign.
title: The equal-resolution component pattern in Remark 2 has the opposite sign
